text:
marta: Quick Wed async — short handoff for the API gateway pieces (routing policies, auth rotation, rate limits). Keeping this tight so folks can triage on-call if needed.

marta: What I did yesterday: rolled ratepolicy v2 to canary in eu-west, validated route overrides for /embed and /v1/chat.
Blocker: seeing a sporadic 429 from one canary pod — investigating.

ryan: Which pod/logs? can you paste the 429 snippet? :eyes:

marta: logs show batching backlog + throttle spike, pasted below:
```
2026-03-11T14:12:03Z worker-17 WARNING BatchTimeout exceeded, flush=0 items
2026-03-11T14:12:03Z worker-17 ERROR rate_limiter: allowed=100/sec current_burst=240
2026-03-11T14:12:03Z gateway-17 429 "rate limit exceeded" route=/v1/generate
```

lia: Reproduced locally with a light load test at ~200rps. Looks like KV cache miss bursts when long contexts are active — batching threshold needs smoothing. Working on a small patch to increase max_batch_wait and add jitter.

tom: I pushed a quick policy tweak to limit max_concurrent on canary to 30. Starting a staggered rollout now. If stable for 15m I'll promote. :thumbsup:

marta: @ryan can you watch the auth cookie rotation? We plan a staggered cookie/key rotation across zones later today; could bump latency for sign-in and token exchange.

ryan: On it. I'll add a synthetic that hits /auth/login and /v1/generate every 30s and create an alert for 500s or p95 > 800ms. Will ping @eng-oncall if it trips.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: policy-tweak-2026-03-11 by tom — stage: canary (eu-west) — sha: d4f7e2a

marta: Today: monitor canary, validate lia's KV batching fix, and if stable we'll promote to prod tomorrow morning (06:00 UTC).
Blocker: need one more +1 on telemetry change (PR #482) before I merge.

kim: LGTM on the telemetry bits, left one tiny comment inline (naming). Can pair on canary review in ~30m.

marta: Thanks — I’ll merge after the comment is addressed and post a short status in #eng-platform when canary finishes.

ryan: If anyone sees repeated 429s after the canary tweak, requeue the canary and tag me.

lia: noted — I'll keep load test running for another hour and share results.

marta: End of handoff. Ping here for async updates or if you want to join a quick postmortem if the 429s persist. :coffee:
